measure: Partner terms signed: bank fee per contribution; share of fund fees paid to DNSE; DNSE's margin on bank bonds in Golden Egg
scale_if: Fee <= VND 3,300; fund share >= 30%; margin >= 0.6 points
adjust_if: Worse on any term: re-run the model and renegotiate before the pilot
stop_if: Fund or bank partner not signed (launch dependency)
derivation: Terms at least as good as the base case keep the plan's economics

measure: Bank fee per contribution (virtual-account collection), VND
stop_if: > 6,191: a dormant saver no longer pays back
derivation: Above VND 6,191 the 60-month CAC ceiling falls below the base acquisition cost of VND 65,000; waiving the fee raises the ceiling from VND 127,512 to VND 198,876

measure: Shadow payday runs with staff accounts: transfers credited on time
derivation: The 4 March 2026 outage stopped orders for two hours (DNSE disclosure)

measure: Projected net cost per new account above VND 10 million by month 60 (model re-run with the pilot's measured values and the signed terms), VND million
derivation: Programme test. The plan is the Board's budget per funded account; downside path 10.02

measure: Enrolment rate of treated dormant accounts (set-up and first contribution within 60 days)
derivation: Break-even rate = reach cost VND 1,300 / 60-month CAC ceiling VND 127,512; scale at 1.5 times break-even

measure: Savers making three contributions in a row
derivation: Scale line = base assumption; stop line = product-fit line of plan_payday.md section 5.6. The cost line is lower: the 60-month CAC ceiling falls to the base acquisition cost of VND 65,000 only at 37.0%
Stop line = contribution at which the 60-month CAC ceiling falls to the base acquisition cost

measure: Share of plan inflows that is new money (tagged by source)
derivation: Money moved from the Never-Sleeping Account or Golden Egg adds no balance
Reliability gate of Round 2 (Table F6, test 6)

measure: Compliance: SSC notice filed; model portfolios signed off by a licensed adviser
derivation: Circular 121/2020, Articles 4 and 24; the 2026 fine for unreported services

measure: Funded savers (three or more contributions in a row)
derivation: Base path of the model; downside path 1,503

measure: Acquisition cost per funded saver, VND
derivation: Base acquisition cost divided by the three-contribution rate

measure: Monthly plan revenue against monthly running cost
derivation: Running cost VND 0.41 billion a month; revenue VND 0.07 billion

measure: New accounts above VND 10 million from the plan
derivation: North Star; savers whose own plan balance has passed VND 10 million

measure: Employer channel: share of employees who enrol after the HR session
adjust_if: 20% to 39%: lower the cost per employer
derivation: At VND 15 million per employer and 300 employees, a saver costs less than the CAC ceiling only from 39% enrolment

measure: Net cost per new account above VND 10 million to date, VND million
stop_if: > 4.1: fold into the core app team or stop
derivation: Same programme test as Gate 1, on actual results
